_doc: Drop logic (GDD 11, D-010): each player's earned Scrip counts toward a threshold; once crossed, that player's next kill drops one (threshold then grows). Also a small base chance per kill. Types come from a shuffled bag; every type appears before repeats.

milestone._doc: Milestone drops (rounds.json milestones, T-078): they last lifetime_seconds (blinking from blink_from_seconds) and are applied for the squad if they expire uncollected; they land ahead_m from the nearest standing player toward the last kill, spacing_m apart, and never count toward max_per_round.

tonic_bottle._doc: The tonic bottle (milestone only, never in the bag): every player still in the match (not bled out) gets a free perk tonic they don't own, at random among the map's perk machines (every perks.json perk if the map has none), no power needed. Under the perk cap only; a full cap gets the next tier of a carried tonic instead (if the profile has unlocked it; the round gate is waived), else full_cap_scrip. Solo Second Wind is skipped once its machine has left.
